findings.evidence: Coherence.lean:90-99; the file's namespace is `EpsilonEridani.QFT.Scattering.Photoproduction`, while `charFun_map_smul` (Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Measure/CharacteristicFunction/Basic.lean:208) and `charFun_stdGaussian` (Mathlib/Probability/Distributions/Gaussian/Multivariate.lean:94) are both upstream-namespace lemmas.
findings.fix: State both for a general `E` in the file this PR already adds for exactly this material, `EpsilonEridani/Mathematics/Probability/Distributions/Gaussian/MultivariateExtensions.lean` (next to `integral_norm_sq_stdGaussian`), and reduce the physics proof to applying them.
findings.issue: Lines 90-92 and 94-99 compute two general facts about the dilated standard Gaussian inline, each as a multi-lemma rewrite chain (the second closed by `push_cast; ring_nf`): `∫ ‖r‖² ∂((stdGaussian E).map (σ • ·)) = σ² * finrank ℝ E` and `charFun ((stdGaussian E).map (σ • ·)) t = exp (-(σ² ‖t‖²)/2)`. Both are statements about Mathlib objects, needlessly specialised to `EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)` and `q.spatialPart`, and are unusable outside this proof.

findings.evidence: Coherence.lean:102-104; MinkowskiProductExtensions.lean:69-71 is the existing sibling fact about `‖p.spatialPart‖` and `⟪p, p⟫ₘ`.
findings.fix: Put it in `Relativity/Tensors/RealTensor/Vector/MinkowskiProductExtensions.lean`, which this PR already edits and which already hosts `norm_spatialPart_eq_sqrt_sq_sub_minkowskiProduct_self`.
findings.issue: Same pattern: `hQ : -⟪q, q⟫ₘ ≤ ‖q.spatialPart‖ ^ 2` — the frame-independent fact that the virtuality never exceeds the squared spatial momentum, advertised as such in the module docstring (line 36) — is proved inline from `minkowskiProduct_self_eq_sq_sub` + `nlinarith`.

findings.evidence: Coherence.lean:106-108; the RHS exponent is `-(-⟪q,q⟫ₘ * (∫ ‖r‖² ∂μ) / d)` (line 88), with `∫ ‖r‖² ∂μ = σ² * d`.
findings.fix: Add a one-line comment saying the `d = 0` branch only handles the `0/0` degeneracy of the statement, or assume `0 < d` and drop the branch.
findings.issue: `rcases eq_or_ne d 0 with rfl | hd` is undocumented. Its only reason is that the statement divides by `d`, so at `d = 0` the bound degenerates to `0/0 = 0`; a reader seeing `nlinarith [sq_nonneg σ, sq_nonneg ‖q.spatialPart‖]` cannot reconstruct why a case split is needed at all.

summary: Proofs are commented, free of `change`/`show` and defeq tricks, and mostly use robust automation. The one recurring defect is that `norm_sq_charFun_map_smul_stdGaussian_spatialPart_le` carries three general, reusable facts about Mathlib/Physlib objects inline as rewrite chains inside a QFT-namespace proof, plus an undocumented degenerate case split.
